items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the lower shriek along a localization reflects injections and surjections (statement lines 5644-5648). The proof is a short reduction: injections and surjections are identified with monomorphisms and epimorphisms (proof line 5651-5652), and the equivalence between the localized category of sheaves and the slice identifies the functor with the projection from the slice, so the assertion becomes the corresponding reflection property of that projection (proof lines 5653-5656). The non-formal content is the identification of the two formulations. The claim is H1: a two-step reduction with each input named.
